in_sanskrit.name: लक्षित
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Someone who has attained their goal or objective, or someone who is skilled in a particular area.

in_hindi.name: लक्षित
in_hindi.long_meaning: पूरा होने वाला, सफलता प्राप्त हुए वाला या कोई कार्यकार्य में विशेषज्योतिर्दिशक.

in_marathi.name: Lakshith
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lakshya + Ith: Goal + Self
in_marathi.long_meaning: Lakshith हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Lakshith is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Lakshya' meaning goal and 'Ith' meaning self. In Hindu mythology, Lord Vishnu is often referred to as 'Lakshmi-Pati' or the protector of Lakshmi, the goddess of wealth and prosperity. The name Lakshith is believed to bring good fortune, success, and prosperity to the bearer.
